customMethods.name: addModeEvent
customMethods.script:
userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	modeInfo = dict(self.view.custom.modeInfo)
	lastModeEventInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.event.getPreviousModeEvent(modeInfo['assetId'], modeInfo['endDate']),0)
	
	#Number of things have to happen here
	#1. We delete all mode events that occurred between the start and upto the end date (but not including)
	system.kanoa.event.deleteModeEvents({'assetId': modeInfo['assetId'], 'startDate': modeInfo['startDate'], 'endDate': modeInfo['endDate']}, userId)

	#2. We add or update the modeEvent at the start time
	#Filter only the keys we want to pass to the function
	keys = {'modeEventId', 'assetId', 'modeCode', 'workOrderId', 'itemId', 'standardRate', 'comment', 'modeSourceId'}
	productionEventInfo = {k: modeInfo[k] for k in keys if k in modeInfo}
	productionEventInfo['tStamp'] = modeInfo['startDate']
	if productionEventInfo['modeSourceId'] is None: productionEventInfo['modeSourceId'] = system.kanoa.asset.getModeSourceId('Schedule')

	modeEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.addProductionEvent(productionEventInfo, userId)	
	if msg:	
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message':msg})
	else:
		#2. We change the tStamp of the last event that falls within the start and end of this new modeEvent to be the end date
		if lastModeEventInfo['modeEventId']:
			productionEventInfo['tStamp'] = modeInfo['endDate']
			productionEventInfo['modeCode'] = lastModeEventInfo['modeCode']
			productionEventInfo['workOrderId'] = lastModeEventInfo['workOrderId']
			productionEventInfo['itemId'] = lastModeEventInfo['itemId']
			modeEventId, msg = system.kanoa.event.addProductionEvent(productionEventInfo, userId)			
			if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': 'Failed to add previous mode. %s'%msg})

	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshProductionData", {})
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.modeEvents")
	self.view.custom.validationCheck = 'Mode has been added'
	self.getChild("flxModeNew").getChild("modeRibbonNew").props.params.values = []
	
	return
